data.name: NotFoundBody
data.value: There is no page at this address.

data.name: ModesHelp
data.value: One temperature per room for each mode. A mode is a name; what it is worth here is the number typed against it.

data.name: ProfileHelp
data.value: Periods that apply only while the day profile mode is in force.

data.name: CalendarsHelp
data.value: Where arrivals are read from, and where finished warm-ups are written down.

data.name: ArrivalCalendarHelp
data.value: Each room is warm at its home temperature by the start of an entry here. Any calendar. An entry with no time is not an arrival.

data.name: RecordCalendarHelp
data.value: One entry per finished warm-up: room, when, and whether it got there. Local calendars only. An entry cannot be taken out again.

data.name: NoCalendarsHelp
data.value: Home Assistant reports none. Set up a calendar integration there first.

data.name: NoLocalCalendarsHelp
data.value: The record needs one Home Assistant keeps itself. Add a local calendar there.

data.name: CalendarNotThereHelp
data.value: Removed or renamed. Nothing is read from it or written to it.

data.name: RoomsHelp
data.value: What each room's sensors are held to, and the numbers the system works out for it.

data.name: AwayIsFrost
data.value: The away temperature is the frost protection. Nothing falls below it.

data.name: ModeNowHelp
data.value: Every room runs the mode in force. A mode chosen here wins while it lasts, then presence takes over again on its own.

data.name: ModeInForceHelp
data.value: The mode the last pass over the rooms ran.

data.name: ModeFromHelp
data.value: Either the dropdown selected it, or somebody chose it here.

data.name: ModeUntilHelp
data.value: When the chosen mode lets go and the dropdown answers again.

data.name: ModeLastsHelp
data.value: Hours the chosen mode holds. It lets go by itself, so a cabin left behind is not heated until the next visit.

data.name: MeaningHelp
data.value: Either heating starts then, or the room must be at the temperature by then.

data.name: ReadsHelp
data.value: The room's own temperature, as its thermostat last reported it.

data.name: ToldHelp
data.value: What this half is telling the room. A warm-up or a hold running in the room wins over it.

data.name: FreshHelp
data.value: A sensor quiet for longer than this leaves the room's average.

data.name: StuckHelp
data.value: A reading held at one value this long leaves the average. A live sensor always wanders a little.

data.name: SpreadHelp
data.value: A fresh reading further than this from the others is left out and reported.

data.name: WindowDelayHelp
data.value: How long an open window waits before the room stops, and a closed one before it resumes.

data.name: BorrowsHelp
data.value: This room has no sensor of its own and holds the named room's temperature instead.

data.name: BorrowsNote
data.value: Change it where the room is set up.

data.name: WarmingRateHelp
data.value: How fast the room warms. It decides when a warm-up starts, so it errs slow.

data.name: OutdoorTermHelp
data.value: How much the outdoor temperature raises the duty the room holds at. It errs high.

data.name: BandHelp
data.value: How far the room may drift before the heat returns. It errs narrow.

data.name: SecondWriterHelp
data.value: Something else changed the shared dropdown while this half was the writer. Switch one of the two to follow.

data.name: PresenceHelp
data.value: Whether this half sets the shared dropdown or follows whatever it holds.

data.name: PresenceMapHelp
data.value: What each option of the dropdown means. Renaming an option in Home Assistant needs the text here changed to match; the state it stands for is untouched.

data.name: UnmappedOptionsHelp
data.value: The dropdown offers these and no row says what they mean, so the heating reads each one as everyday. Pick a state for each.

data.name: VersionsHelp
data.value: A setting that is missing is usually a feature one half does not have yet.
